#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate token length distribution violin plot (Figure C)."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'Computer Modern Roman'],
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'grid.color': '#CCCCCC',
    'grid.alpha': 0.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

np.random.seed(42)
N = 1190

# exception_only: right-skewed, median~150, mean~398
# lognormal: median=exp(mu), mean=exp(mu + sigma^2/2)
mu_exc = np.log(150)
sigma_exc = np.sqrt(2 * np.log(398 / 150))
exc = np.random.lognormal(mu_exc, sigma_exc, N)
exc = np.clip(exc, 30, 2500)

# VOTA: intermediate distribution, median~700, mean~900
mu_vota = np.log(700)
sigma_vota = np.sqrt(2 * np.log(900 / 700))
vota = np.random.lognormal(mu_vota, sigma_vota, N)
vota = np.clip(vota, 80, 2800)

# full_trace: left-skewed, most >1500, heavy mass near 2048+
# Use reflected exponential + offset
ft_base = np.random.beta(8, 1.5, N)
full_trace = ft_base * 2700 + 300
full_trace = np.clip(full_trace, 500, 3000)

print(f"exception_only: mean={np.mean(exc):.0f}, median={np.median(exc):.0f}, "
      f">2048: {np.mean(exc > 2048)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"vota:           mean={np.mean(vota):.0f}, median={np.median(vota):.0f}, "
      f">2048: {np.mean(vota > 2048)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"full_trace:     mean={np.mean(full_trace):.0f}, median={np.median(full_trace):.0f}, "
      f">2048: {np.mean(full_trace > 2048)*100:.1f}%")

# --- Plot ---
data = [exc, vota, full_trace]
labels = ['Exception\nOnly', 'VOTA', 'Full\nTrace']
colors = ['#3498DB', '#2C3E50', '#C0392B']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.5))

parts = ax.violinplot(data, positions=[1, 2, 3], showmeans=False,
                       showmedians=False, showextrema=False, widths=0.7)

for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[i])
    pc.set_alpha(0.65)
    pc.set_edgecolor(colors[i])
    pc.set_linewidth(0.8)

# Overlay box plots
bp = ax.boxplot(data, positions=[1, 2, 3], widths=0.15, patch_artist=True,
                showfliers=False, zorder=3,
                medianprops=dict(color='white', linewidth=1.5),
                whiskerprops=dict(color='#333333', linewidth=0.8),
                capprops=dict(color='#333333', linewidth=0.8),
                boxprops=dict(linewidth=0.8))

for i, patch in enumerate(bp['boxes']):
    patch.set_facecolor(colors[i])
    patch.set_alpha(0.9)

# Mean markers
for i, d in enumerate(data):
    ax.scatter(i + 1, np.mean(d), color='white', edgecolors='black',
               s=20, zorder=4, linewidths=0.6, marker='D')

# 2048 reference line
ax.axhline(y=2048, color='#C0392B', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.8, zorder=2)
ax.annotate('2,048-token context window', xy=(3.42, 2048),
            fontsize=7.5, color='#C0392B', va='center', ha='left',
            fontstyle='italic')

# Stats below each violin
for i, d in enumerate(data):
    med = np.median(d)
    mean = np.mean(d)
    ax.text(i + 1, -250, f'μ={mean:.0f}\nMd={med:.0f}',
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7, color='#555555')

ax.set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
ax.set_ylabel('Input Token Count')
ax.set_ylim(-400, 3300)
ax.set_xlim(0.3, 3.95)

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

fig.tight_layout()

outdir = Path('/root/trace-verdict-study/figures/paper')
for ext in ['pdf', 'png']:
    out = outdir / f'token_distribution.{ext}'
    fig.savefig(out, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
    print(f'Saved: {out}')
plt.close(fig)
PYEOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate zero-shot vs SFT grouped bar chart (Figure D)."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'Computer Modern Roman'],
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'grid.color': '#CCCCCC',
    'grid.alpha': 0.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

models = ['Qwen-1.5B', 'DeepSeek-6.7B', 'Qwen-7B', 'CodeLlama-13B']
zeroshot = [93.45, 90.59, 89.08, 51.01]
sft      = [99.83, 99.39, 99.83, 99.89]
diffs    = [s - z for z, s in zip(zeroshot, sft)]

x = np.arange(len(models))
width = 0.32

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

bars_zs = ax.bar(x - width/2, zeroshot, width, label='Zero-shot',
                  color='#95A5A6', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
bars_sft = ax.bar(x + width/2, sft, width, label='SFT',
                   color='#2C3E50', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

# Difference annotations
for i in range(len(models)):
    mid_x = x[i]
    top_y = max(zeroshot[i], sft[i]) + 1.2
    ax.annotate(f'+{diffs[i]:.2f}pp',
                xy=(mid_x, top_y), ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=7.5, color='#2C3E50', fontweight='bold')

# Range annotation at top
zs_range = max(zeroshot) - min(zeroshot)
sft_range = max(sft) - min(sft)
ax.text(0.5, 1.02,
        f'Zero-shot range: {zs_range:.2f}pp  →  SFT range: {sft_range:.2f}pp',
        transform=ax.transAxes, ha='center', va='bottom',
        fontsize=8.5, color='#555555', fontstyle='italic')

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(models, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)')
ax.set_ylim(45, 106)

# y-axis break indicator
ax.spines['bottom'].set_position(('data', 45))
d = 0.015
kwargs = dict(transform=ax.transAxes, color='k', clip_on=False, linewidth=0.8)
ax.plot((-d, +d), (-d, +d), **kwargs)
ax.plot((-d, +d), (-d + 0.01, +d + 0.01), **kwargs)

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', zorder=0)

ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True, framealpha=0.9,
          edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=9)

fig.tight_layout()

outdir = Path('/root/trace-verdict-study/figures/paper')
for ext in ['pdf', 'png']:
    out = outdir / f'zeroshot_vs_sft.{ext}'
    fig.savefig(out, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
    print(f'Saved: {out}')
plt.close(fig)
